summary.zh: 规划文献综述的检索策略与阅读框架
summary.en: Plan a literature review with PICO or SPIDER and a reading guide.

description.zh: 为文献综述选定 PICO、SPIDER 等检索框架，在 PubMed 和 OpenAlex 检索并整理成一份 .docx 入门指南。适合刚启动综述、需要先摸清领域脉络时使用。检索依赖联网，单篇论文查询直接提问即可。
description.en: Picks a PICO or SPIDER search frame, runs PubMed and OpenAlex queries and writes a .docx orientation guide for a literature review. Useful at the start of a review. Needs web access; single-paper lookups are best asked directly.
